checks.check: Security: Store.getActiveByName() uses bound parameter for name
checks.detail: src/definition/store.zig getActiveByName(): SQL is `WHERE name = $1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'` with `&.{name}` as the bound parameter slice. No SQL string interpolation of user data.

checks.check: Security: Store.list() stage filter uses bound parameter
checks.detail: src/definition/store.zig list(): stage filter appends `stage = ${d}` (parameterised placeholder via pidx) and binds the stage value via bound.append(). The SQL string contains only constant literals — no user input is interpolated.

checks.check: Security: handleList validates ?status= before calling Store
checks.detail: src/api/routes/definitions.zig handleList(): status_filter block checks raw string against exactly four known enum values (DRAFT, ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED) and returns errorResult(422, ...) for any other value before any store call is made.

Upper bound enforced: ps > 200 returns HTTP 422. Lower bound gap: ps == 0 maps to default 50 (`if (ps == 0) break :blk 50;`) instead of returning HTTP 422 as required by API-06. This is NON_BLOCKING — the behavior is safe (returns data, not a security vulnerability) but is a spec non-conformance. See ISSUE-PD-07-10. Fix: change the guard to `if (ps == 0) return errorResult(allocator, 422, "page_size must be between 1 and 200");`

checks.check: Security: cursor decode uses safe base64 decoder with explicit error handling
checks.detail: decodeCursor() in src/api/routes/definitions.zig uses std.base64.url_safe_no_pad.Decoder. Both calcSizeForSlice and decode are called with `catch return error.InvalidCursor`. handleList() propagates this to errorResult(422, "invalid cursor"). No unsafe decode path exists.

migrations/014_definition_stage.sql exists. Content: `ALTER TABLE process_definitions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stage TEXT;` and `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_def_stage ON process_definitions(stage) WHERE stage IS NOT NULL;`. Both DDL statements use IF NOT EXISTS — idempotent and safe.

checks.check: API-06 cursor contract: opaque base64url encode/decode
checks.detail: encodeCursor() serialises created_at µs as decimal string then encodes via std.base64.url_safe_no_pad.Encoder. decodeCursor() reverses this via url_safe_no_pad.Decoder. handleList() converts the decoded decimal to i64 via std.fmt.parseInt with explicit error handling (returns 422 on failure). Cursors are fully opaque to the client.

issues.description: handleList in src/api/routes/definitions.zig maps page_size=0 to the default value of 50 instead of returning HTTP 422 as required by PD-07/API-06. The guard `if (ps == 0) break :blk 50;` must be changed to return an error response.
issues.fix_required: Change `if (ps == 0) break :blk 50;` to `if (ps == 0) return errorResult(allocator, 422, "page_size must be between 1 and 200");`
